errors.evidence: The x-axis has six categories (mBERT-0, mBERT-10, mBERT-30, mBERT-50, mBERT-80, mBERT-100), not five.
The y-axis range shown in the chart is from 82% to 90%, not 92%.

errors.text_span: 一条为红色实线带有圆形标记，代表精确率。
errors.evidence: The legend indicates that the red line represents 'Recall (召回率)', not '精确率' (Precision).

errors.text_span: 另一条为绿色实线带有圆形标记，代表召回率。
errors.evidence: The legend indicates that the green line represents 'F1 Score (F1分数)', not '召回率' (Recall).

errors.text_span: 最后一条为蓝色的虚线，带有圆形标记，代表F1 分数。
errors.evidence: The legend indicates that the blue line represents 'Precision (精度)', not 'F1 分数'. Additionally, the blue line is solid, not '虚线' (dashed).

errors.text_span: 在 mBERT-10 时达到约 84%, 保持稳定, 在 mBERT-30 时变为 85%
errors.evidence: The red line (Recall) value at mBERT-10 is approximately 85.8%, not 84%. The value at mBERT-30 is approximately 86.6%, not 85%. The line is not stable between these points; it increases.
The red line (Recall) value at mBERT-80 is approximately 89.8%, not 88%.
The green line (F1 Score) value at mBERT-10 is approximately 84.8%, not 83%.
The green line (F1 Score) value at mBERT-50 is approximately 86.9%, not 85%.
The blue line (Precision) value at mBERT-0 is approximately 81.2%, not 83%.
